note: English-language competitors analyzed for title/hook patterns. Our channel is Spanish.

channels.title_formula: ✝️God Says: [Full sentence conveying mystery/urgency/personal revelation] | God's Message Today

title_structure.body: Full natural-language sentence (not caps-lock), often 6–10 words
title_structure.tone: personal, intimate, 'meant for you', mystery + emotional payoff

top_videos.title: You Were Meant to Hear This Today
The Decision You Make After This Video
I Am Not Done With You Yet
Something Beautiful Is Coming Your Way
Your Breakthrough Is Closer Than You Think
I Have Been Watching Over You
Do Not Give Up — I Have a Plan

winning_hooks: destiny/fate language ('meant to hear', 'waiting for you')
divine persistence ('not done with you yet', 'watching over you')
imminent breakthrough ('closer than you think', 'coming your way')

channels.title_formula: God Says: "[CAPS ACTION/REVELATION]" | God | Gods Message Now Today | God's Message Now For You

title_structure.body: SHORT CAPS phrase in quotes — 2–5 words, imperative or revelation
title_structure.suffix: | God | Gods Message Now Today | God's Message Now For You

top_videos.title: I NEED YOU TO SEE THIS
I CHOSE YOU BEFORE YOU WERE BORN
I AM ABOUT TO CHANGE YOUR LIFE

winning_hooks: caps urgency ('I NEED YOU TO SEE THIS', 'OPEN IT NOW')
divine election ('I CHOSE YOU BEFORE YOU WERE BORN')
imminent transformation ('I AM ABOUT TO CHANGE YOUR LIFE')
season shift language ('YOUR SEASON IS SHIFTING')

channels.note: Grammatical errors (GOD SAY instead of GOD SAYS), less polished — avoid this style

key_insights.best_performing_formula: God Says: [Personal revelation sentence] — intimate, destiny-focused, 6-10 words
key_insights.avoid: ALL-CAPS shouting without warmth, grammatical errors, generic phrases like 'God bless you'

suffix_options: | El Mensaje de Dios Para Ti Hoy

title_patterns_that_work: [Subject pronoun] + [personal verb] + [you/your] — e.g. 'Estoy a punto de cambiar tu vida'
Divine persistence — 'No he terminado contigo aún'
Imminent breakthrough — 'Tu milagro está más cerca de lo que crees'
Urgency to watch — 'Necesitas escuchar esto hoy'
description_best_practices: First sentence hooks immediately — no intro fluff
Reference specific struggle viewer might have
Include call to action: subscribe, share with someone who needs this
Add relevant Spanish hashtags at end
